description: Register of actual decisions from bank, counsel, regulator, custodian, assurance provider. Each record has: decision_id, party, decision, date, scope, source, conditions, implications, next_action. Do not convert discussion into a decision.
note: The decisions array is EMPTY. Zero external decisions have been made. Per Section Q: 'Do not convert discussion into a decision.' A decision requires actual decision evidence (signed decision document, formal letter, board resolution, or equivalent). A discussion (even a positive one) is NOT a decision.
no_discussion_as_decision_rule: enforced — a discussion (meeting, email thread, verbal exchange) is NOT a decision. A decision requires formal decision evidence. This register accepts only actual decisions with documentary evidence.
